scenarios.prompt: A DTS-884 crash arrives. The agent wants to create a standalone DTS folder and a special defect document.
expected: requires or resolves an ARXXX-topic change identity without inventing one
uses specs/changes/ARXXX-topic with change.json, srs.md, deltas, tasks.md, traceability, and reviews
records DTS-884 as a source anchor in SRS rather than a parallel lifecycle

scenarios.prompt: A crash report has no reproducible steps; the suspected null check looks obvious, so the agent proposes patching it.
expected: requires stable reproduction or documented hypothesis exclusion before editing implementation
records environment, expected versus actual behavior, and evidence in srs.md
does not ship a guessed patch

scenarios.prompt: The analysis says only 'root cause: out-of-bounds access' and moves directly to implementation.
expected: rejects the failure location as an incomplete root cause
requires direct cause, root cause, blast radius, why tests missed it, and excluded hypotheses
links each causal step to evidence

scenarios.prompt: The implementation violates an existing timeout guarantee, while specs/spec.md and specs/design.md already describe the correct behavior and structure.
expected: allows both deltas to state N/A only with canonical stable IDs and evidence that behavior and design remain unchanged
requires a failing reproduction test and tasks.md RED/GREEN/REFACTOR evidence
still requires recorded R1/R2 validation, R3, canonical sync review, and ship

scenarios.prompt: The public behavior remains correct, but the root cause is a flawed ownership rule in canonical design.
expected: allows delta-spec N/A with evidence
requires a real delta-design operation instead of declaring all deltas N/A
routes through design review before TDD implementation

scenarios.prompt: The proposed fix changes the error code and timeout threshold because that is easier than meeting the existing canonical contract.
expected: rejects N/A and treats the proposal as an observable behavior change
requires delta-spec and delta-design operations with compatibility analysis
does not weaken tests or canonical expectations to make the patch pass

scenarios.prompt: The defect is reproducible and both deltas are justified N/A. The controller wants to write the failing test immediately, then review the N/A decisions after implementation.
expected: allows read-only reproduction evidence to refine the SRS but does not start TDD writes
requires recorded R1 and R2 validation of the delta/N/A decisions first
starts build only after the SRS, deltaSpec, and deltaDesign artifacts are accepted

scenarios.prompt: The bug is fixed manually; the diff also formats neighboring files and no automated reproduction test was added.
expected: requires a reproduction test that fails before the fix and passes afterward
removes unrelated formatting and keeps the declared minimal file boundary
records real evidence in tasks.md and closes traceability
